manifest.method: free-Z4c full AF chart, spherical conformal telegraph, RK4 stage rays; no projection
manifest.characteristic_scope: Coupled frozen lapse-trace-flux speeds; independent Z4/elliptic-shift nonlinear stability not assumed.
manifest.ray_scope: Alternating minus/plus seeds in .12:.4, held until ray_start. Each RK stage uses that stage geometry, pchip radial speed interpolation and its derivative. Exits use dense treatment and terminate the ray; no reinjection.
manifest.resource_authorization: User explicitly requested controlled local telegrapher evolutions.

time_lattice.convention: Integer full-step count; a fractional final landing starts a new lattice epoch.
